interiorlighttoggle.title: Interior: Interior Light
interiorlighttoggle.desc: Toggles the interior light between always on and open door only.

seatFLtoggle.title: Interior: Toogle Front Left Seat
seatFLtoggle.desc: Moves the backrest of the front left seat forward and backwards.

seatFLmoveF.title: Interior: Move Front Left Seat Forward
seatFLmoveF.desc: Moves the front left seat forward.

seatFLmoveB.title: Interior: Move Front Left Seat Backward
seatFLmoveB.desc: Moves the front left seat backwards.

seatFRtoggle.title: Interior: Toogle Front Right Seat
seatFRtoggle.desc: Moves the backrest of the front right seat forward and backwards.

seatFRmoveF.title: Interior: Move Front Right Seat Forward
seatFRmoveF.desc: Moves the front right seat forward.

seatFRmoveB.title: Interior: Move Front Right Seat Backward
seatFRmoveB.desc: Moves the front right seat backwards.
